title: Abantu Abaneqiniso BaseMakkah
intro: Ezinsukwini zokuqala zesambulo, lapho isigijimi seqiniso sibhekene nokuphikiswa okukhulu, imiphefumulo ethile yema iqinile ekuqinisekeni kwayo. Laba bakholwa babhekana nonya olungenakucatshangwa oluvela kulabo ababefuna ukucima ukukhanya kokholo. Ukuhlupheka kwabo kwakunzima, ukuhlupheka kwabo kwakukhulu—kodwa izilimi zabo azizange ziyeke ukumemezela ubunye buka-Allah. Ngisho nalapho bephonswa ekujuleni kokuphelelwa yithemba, isivikelo saphezulu sabazungezile, siguqula ukuvivinywa kwabo kwaba ubufakazi bokholo baphakade. Ake sihlole uhambo lwale miphefumulo emangalisayo.
clues: Savivinywa ngesijeziso esinzima ngokwenqaba ukulahla ukholo lwethu kuNkulunkulu oyedwa
Abantu bethu babengenakukwazi ukuphula isinqumo sethu, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi unya lwabo lwaba ludala kangakanani
Sasimiswa emthonjeni emini, kodwa usizo lukaNkulunkulu lwaluseduze njalo
Ukuqina kwethu kwamangaza ngisho nalabo ababona ukukhuthazela kwethu
Abaningi eMakkah bafuna ukusiphoqa ukuba sihoxe, kodwa sahlala siqinile
Lapho konke kubonakala sengathi kulahlekile, inkululeko yethu yafika ngokungenelela okumangalisayo kwaphezulu
